name: frontend-kit
description: A complete Claude Code setup for React + TypeScript frontends, in four profiles: website (TanStack Start), dashboard (Vite, Next.js or TanStack Start), react (any React stack) and fullstack (site + admin in one tree). Skills, agents, git and live-site guards, format/lint on edit, quality gates, MCP servers, and project templates installed by /frontend-kit:setup. Arabic RTL + English first-class.
